workflow_runs.display_title: docs(app): fix misplaced backtick in session/g/current_app sentence

head_commit.message:
docs(app): fix misplaced backtick in session/g/current_app sentence

:data:`g:,` had the closing backtick after the comma, so RST parsed
'g:, and :data:' as a broken reference and rendered .current_app as a
plain literal instead of a cross-reference. Same sentence in
request_context and test_request_context.
